programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: Polar landscapes in autumn are transformed as the big freeze returns. Most animals leave on epic journeys, some now battle to breed, and for the hardy few it's a time of opportunity. In the Arctic, polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast to wait for the return of the ice. Tempers soon fray and violent contests break out. Off the coast 2,000 beluga whales head for a special estuary, a gigantic 'whale spa'.

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: Winter is the greatest test for life in the polar regions, as temperatures plummet to 70 below and winds reach 200kph. Out on the frozen ocean, the entire population of the world's spectacled eider ducks braves the winter in a giant ice hole.

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: Revealing the extraordinary riches and wonders of the polar regions that have kept people visiting them for thousands of years. programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: It is high summer in the polar regions, and the sun never sets. Vast hordes of summer visitors cram a lifetime of drama into one long, magical day; they must feed, fight and rear their young in this brief window of plenty. Summer is a tough time for the polar bear family, as their ice world melts away and the cubs take their first swimming lesson.

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: Polar landscapes in autumn are transformed as the big freeze returns. Most animals leave on epic journeys, some now battle to breed, and for the hardy few it's a time of opportunity. In the Arctic, polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast to wait for the return of the ice. Tempers soon fray and violent contests break out. Off the coast 2,000 beluga whales head for a special estuary, a gigantic 'whale spa'.

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: Winter is the greatest test for life in the polar regions, as temperatures plummet to 70 below and winds reach 200kph. Only a few remarkable survivors gamble on remaining in these extreme conditions. In the Arctic, a female polar bear treks into the mountains to give birth. Out on the frozen ocean, the entire population of the world's spectacled eider ducks braves the winter in a giant ice hole.

programme.title: Frozen Planet
programme.desc: Revealing the extraordinary riches and wonders of the polar regions that have kept people visiting them for thousands of years. Today, their survival relies on a combination of ancient wisdom and cutting-edge science. Most Arctic people live in Siberia, either in cities like Norilsk - the coldest city on earth - or out on the tundra, where tribes like the Dolgan survive by herding reindeer.

Hendricks has gained access to Russian nuclear launch codes and is planning a strike on the United States, but will the new team be able to stop the impending disaster?

programme.title: Anaconda

Terri and her crew, which includes an anthropologist and a cameraman, come across Paul, who is stranded on the riverbank. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.

programme.title: The Lost Boys

programme.title: Total Recall

Determined to find the meaning of these dreams, he visits Rekall Inc - a specialist in memory implants - intent on buying a memory trip to Mars, but the implant brings to the surface long-lost clues as to Quaid's true identity.

programme.title: Deep Impact

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: A reprogrammed killer cyborg arrives in Los Angeles to protect a future leader from a shape-shifting assassin.

programme.title: Star Trek Generations
programme.desc: The maiden voyage of the third Starship Enterprise is jeopardised by mad scientist Soran. Only one man knows how to stop the boffin, but he's been dead 78 years.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact

Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering, and eventually participating in, the Battle of Hue.

The story is told in flashback years afterwards by one of the boys - now a writer - and revolves around their search through the countryside around their hometown for the body of a missing teenager, thought to have been killed by a train. Adapted from 'The Body', a novella by Stephen King.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievement in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief. We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Málaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Čech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot-stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: From his early years in Ivory Coast to leaving Africa for Europe, Amad Diallo's journey has been one of talent, determination and sacrifice. After making his breakthrough in Italy, his potential earned him a dream move to Manchester United, where he has fought to establish himself on the Premier League stage. We follow Amad's remarkable rise and the journey that has taken him from humble beginnings to the heights of Old Trafford.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: John Stones has experienced almost everything the game can offer; from the pressure of the biggest stage to the injuries and setbacks that have tested him along the way. After more than a decade at the heart of the Premier League, winning its biggest honours and helping redefine the role of a modern defender, he now takes his career in a new direction.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption stories.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: Once the last line of defence, today's goalkeeper is expected to be so much more. From sweeper-keepers to playing out under pressure, we explore the innovations, characters and changing demands that have revolutionised one of football's most fascinating positions.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: Ipswich Town legend and former Sunderland striker Marcus Stewart built a career on taking on some of football's toughest challenges. Now, he faces a very different battle; one that has changed his life beyond the pitch and revealed a strength and determination far greater than anything football demanded of him.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: Aston Villa's 1992/93 season had all the ingredients of a defining football story. Through special behind-the-scenes footage, PL Stories takes viewers inside Ron Atkinson's Villa, revealing the characters, camaraderie and mounting pressure of a gripping title challenge. From the dressing room to the drama on the pitch, this is the inside story of Villa's pursuit of the first Premier League crown.

programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.desc: Duck is a referee at a football match, and Frog sees how much a footballer is cheered for scoring a goal. He is desperate to score one himself, but can he get past Duck's red card?

programme.title: Pokémon Horizons: The Series
programme.desc: Liko worries that Hattrem could be holding itself back for the sake of others.

programme.title: Winx Club: The Magic Is Back
programme.desc: Darkness spreads all over Alfea as Flora's parents arrive to help the Winx.

programme.title: The Next Step: Cheer
programme.desc: Cammy accidentally starts a rumour. Damian challenges Layla. Melody tries to catch a cold.

programme.title: Newsround
programme.desc: News magazine keeping young viewers up to date with the latest stories and events happening at home and abroad.

programme.title: Blue Peter
programme.desc: Big Zuu joins Hacker, Abby, and Joel in the Blue Peter studio to support Children in Need.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: Steve Backshall heads to downtown Perth in search of the most beautiful spider on earth.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don visits the world's 80 most inspiring gardens: this time, in South East Asia. Since the 19th century, Western gardeners have loved the tropical garden. Monty visits the archetype, the mysterious Jim Thompson's Garden in Bangkok. He seeks something more authentic in the Royal Palace gardens and the floating gardens of the canals of Bangkok. In Bali, his preconceptions are challenged again.

programme.title: Naturewatch
programme.desc: Chris Packham, Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin explore why geese fly in a V formation, why leaves change colour in autumn and why birds eat rocks.

programme.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
programme.desc: Rod Stewart and Penny Lancaster welcome Anita Rani into their home to discuss life, family, fame and faith, sharing festive memories, Rod's rise to stardom and Penny's police work.

programme.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
programme.desc: Nadiya presents the very best weekend breakfasts for kicking back, relaxing and really indulging in the pleasure of the day's first meal. First up are Nadiya's delectable granola cupcakes for a delicious breakfast on the go.

programme.title: Ice Cold in Alex
programme.desc: A British officer and his ambulance crew discover a German spy in their midst during a harrowing desert trek through Libya in 1942.

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Martin wants to run for the hills because of a tricky legal issue in Devon. Jacqui is in Eastbourne, where work is already under way at an end-of-terrace. And Dion goes to Northampton, where a smelly cellar is hard to cope with!

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The team is at Wolverhampton Art Gallery. Antiques experts James Lewis and Caroline Hawley unearth a sword with a dark history and an early Moorcroft vase, while Paul Martin explores some of the region's industrial past.

programme.title: Live: Match of the Day Wales
programme.desc: Live coverage as Norway takes on Wales in the UEFA Nations League.

programme.title: Live: UEFA Nations League Football
programme.desc: Stephen Watson presents full match coverage from Windsor Park as Northern Ireland take on Ukraine in the UEFA Nations League. With just two matches remaining, Northern Ireland remain firmly in contention for promotion from League B. However, Ukraine could provide a major test as Michael O'Neill's side look to bolster their position ahead of a potentially decisive final fixture. Commentary is by Thomas Kane and Stephen Craigan.

programme.title: 40 Hits of 1985 at the BBC
programme.desc: Featuring the best of the BBC's archives for this selection of 40 songs from 1985, including the likes of Elton John, Duran Duran, Foreigner, Billy Ocean, Marillion, Go West, Strawberry Switchblade and Kirsty MacColl.

programme.title: Godland
programme.desc: At the end of the 19th century, a young Danish priest is sent to a remote part of Iceland. The deeper he travels into the Icelandic landscape, the more he loses a sense of his own reality, his mission and his sense of duty.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: The tragic events of the party send shock waves through the Phelans. As dangerous secrets threaten to come to light, Michael is forced to make a difficult confession to Diana. Meanwhile, unseen dangers close in, and it becomes clear no-one is safe.

programme.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
programme.desc: The second leg of the race takes the teams across the heart of Borneo to a modern metropolis on its eastern coast and their second checkpoint.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani
programme.desc: Anita Rani meets Paralympian and broadcaster Ade Adepitan to hear his inspirational life story and how sport, spirituality and the festive season have shaped him. Anita discovers his life-affirming Christmas story, from contracting polio as a toddler in Nigeria, to growing up with a disability in east London in the 1970s, to the rocky road that led to Paralympic glory with the British wheelchair basketball team. Now a respected broadcaster, Ade shines a light on causes close to his heart.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Charlotte Smith and Adam Henson explore how dairy farmers across County Antrim are turning to tech and innovative business models to build a more resilient future.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: Dougie visits a nature reserve in Castlemilk that has transformed into a thriving green place. Meanwhile, Anne hears about a charity providing bereavement support for kids across the Highlands.

programme.title: BBC Children in Need
programme.desc: Radio 1 presenter Sian Eleri follows Pudsey Bear's clues on a road trip around Wales to meet the special young people and projects benefiting from BBC Children in Need funding.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Andi Oliver takes a classic British dessert and transforms it into a savoury number with her three cheese and leek bread and butter pudding. Niklas Ekstedt brings the taste of Sweden to the studio with the iconic Jansson's temptation.

programme.title: Best Bakes Ever
programme.desc: With Britain more obsessed with baking than ever, actress and cake expert Jane Asher brings together a selection of recipes from the nation's favourite television chefs, for 'Best Bakes Ever'.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Nigel Slater creates simple but delicious meals from ingredients that are often overlooked, including a lentil and chard stew.

programme.title: Jane Eyre
programme.desc: Charlotte Bronte's classic about an orphan girl who grows up to become a governess in a gloomy manor in Yorkshire, where she falls in love with the mysterious Edward Rochester.

programme.title: Spellbound
programme.desc: Hitchcock thriller in which a psychoanalyst falls in love with her new boss, knowing that he is an amnesiac who may be a killer and an impostor. Characteristically Hitchcockian twists blur reality and imagination as the psychoanalyst struggles to restore his memory. A dream sequence designed by Salvador Dali adds to the suspense.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: A collection of interesting finds from the show's travels round the country, visiting Margam Country Park in south Wales, Highcliffe Castle in Dorset and Powderham Castle in Devon. Paul also takes a look at the treasures at Firle Place.
